summary_1line: Markandeya recounts how Manu rescues a fish who warns of a coming cosmic flood and guides an ark carrying sages and seeds to safety.

image_candidates.scene_text: A tiny shining fish pleads for protection as the ascetic Manu lifts it gently from the riverbank with cupped hands.
A colossal horned fish pulls Manu’s ark with the seven sages through a stormy, world-covering ocean.
The ark is tied to a snowy Himalayan peak while endless floodwaters stretch to the horizon beneath dark skies.
